JSON Formatter

Paste JSON to pretty-print it with 2 or 4 space indentation, minify it, or validate it with precise error messages.


    

      
      
    

  

  
All processing happens in your browser — your JSON is never uploaded.




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste your JSON into the input box, or click Sample to load an example.
  2. Choose Format (2-space), Format (4-space), Minify, or Validate.
  3. Read the result, or the exact parse error if the JSON is invalid.
  4. Copy the result or download it as a .json file.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What happens if my JSON is invalid?
The tool shows the exact JSON.parse error, including the character position where parsing failed, so you can find the problem quickly.
Does Minify remove anything besides whitespace?
Minify removes all unnecessary whitespace, producing the most compact valid JSON. Great for shrinking payloads.
Is my JSON sent to a server?
Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser — your JSON is never sent to any server.
